segments.title: Signal now BLOCKS Siri AI from your chats
segments.say: Signal now blocks Siri AI from reading your chats. It's on by default.

segments.title: It blocks screenshots too
segments.say: It blocks screenshots too, so phone AI can't scan your chats.

segments.title: Need one screenshot?
segments.say: Need a screenshot? Switch it off for ten minutes.

segments.title: Signal 8.37 on iOS 27
segments.say: It's in Signal eight point three seven on iOS twenty seven.

segments.title: Source: MacRumors
segments.say: Source: MacRumors. Not tested by us.
